title: esy manager
noStoresBody: Create your first store on esy.ge and it will appear here.

access.title: Manage your store
access.body: Sign in with the same Google account you opened your store with, or the one you were given the manager role on.
access.noneBody: Open your first store on esy.ge and it will show up here.
access.noneHint: Working in someone else’s store? Ask the owner to give this email the manager role.

firstVisit.title: Your store is live
firstVisit.left_one: {{count}} step left before you can take orders.
firstVisit.left_other: {{count}} steps left before you can take orders.
firstVisit.name: Name and link
firstVisit.emptyBody: When someone buys, the order will show up here.
firstVisit.noOrdersBody: When someone buys, the order will show up here. Share your store link on Instagram or WhatsApp.

cancel.title: Cancel the order
cancel.stock: The items go back into stock
cancel.email: The buyer gets an email. No SMS is sent for a cancellation.
cancel.money: The {{amount}} paid does not come back by itself. Tick the box below to send the refund too.
cancel.moneyManager: The {{amount}} paid does not come back by itself. Only the owner can send money back.
cancel.refundToo: Send {{amount}} back to the buyer through the bank
cancel.rules: An order can be cancelled while it is placed or shipped. After delivery it is a refund instead. Only the owner can send money back.
cancel.failed: The order could not be cancelled.
cancel.refundFailed: The order is cancelled, but the refund could not be sent.

products.title: Products
products.emptyBody: Add your first product and it goes live on your storefront immediately.

signInRequired: Sign in to manage your stores

settings.integrationsNote: The payment keys belong to your shop — money goes straight to your account; esy never holds it.

team.title: Team
team.sub: Who can run this store. Store roles are separate from platform administration.
team.empty: Nobody else has a role in this store yet.
team.addHint: The account must have signed in at least once — identities come from Google, so an address nobody has used yet cannot be given a role.
team.removeConfirm: Remove {{email}} from this store? They lose access to the back office; their shopping history is untouched.
team.removeSelfConfirm: Remove your own access to this store? You will not be able to return unless another owner adds you back.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.excludes: Revenue excludes refunded and cancelled orders, and excludes delivery — a courier charge passes through you, not to you. The order count is every order placed.
stats.lifetimeOnly: These are lifetime totals. The 7 / 30 / 90-day windows and the top-products list are designed but not built, so no period selector is shown rather than one that changes nothing.

money.title: Money
money.sub: What you earned, and what the platform charges ({{percent}}% of goods).
money.howBody: {{percent}}% of the goods total is calculated when an order is placed and frozen onto it, so a later rate change never rewrites what you already owe. It is charged on goods alone — never on delivery, and never on an order that was refunded or cancelled.
money.deliveryNote: Delivery you collect is not revenue. It is passed to the courier, and no fee is charged on it.
money.noSettlement: The fee accrues but no statement is sent yet, and there is no payment process behind it. Nothing is owed until that exists.

overview.title: Overview
overview.loadFailed: Could not load this store’s figures.
overview.excludes: Revenue excludes refunded and cancelled orders, and excludes delivery — a courier charge passes through you, not to you.
overview.allDone: Nothing is waiting — every order is moving.

orders.title: Orders
orders.emptyBody: When someone buys, the order lands here and the buyer gets an email.
orders.emptyFilterBody: No order currently sits at this step. Try another filter.
orders.buyerNotified: The buyer sees this status on their order page and is told by SMS and email.
orders.refundNotRevenue: A refunded order is not revenue: it is excluded from your payout and from the platform fee.

detail.twoStatusNote: Fulfilment and payment are separate. A delivered order can still be unpaid, and a paid order can still be cancelled.
detail.cancelConfirm: Cancel this order? The items go back to stock.
detail.cancelNote: A store can cancel while an order is placed or shipped. After delivery it is a return, which is a different flow.
detail.pickupInStore: Collection in store — no delivery address
detail.refundFailed: The refund could not be sent.
detail.refundNote: The bank processes refunds asynchronously, so this will show as pending until they confirm it. The order stays as it is — a refund is not a cancellation.
detail.refundOwnerOnly: Only the store owner can issue a refund.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.loadFailed: The figures could not be loaded.
analytics.noneBefore: No sales in the previous {{days}} days
analytics.noneBeforeOrders: No orders in the previous {{days}} days
analytics.excludes: Revenue and the average order leave out cancelled and refunded orders, and do not include delivery.
analytics.topNone: Nothing sold in this period yet.

finances.title: Finances
finances.sub: What you receive and what you pay esy: {{percent}}% of goods

whatBody.goods: Card payments come from Bank of Georgia straight to your account. esy never holds them.
whatBody.delivery: You pay the courier. It is not counted as revenue and carries no commission.
whatBody.refunds: The bank returns it to the shopper, and that order's commission is written off.

finances.feeNote: {{percent}}% of the goods is counted when an order is placed and is never taken from your account. No invoice is sent yet; you will hear how to pay before one is.

shop.tagline: Short description · shown under the name

delivery.noCardLead: Card payments are not on yet.
delivery.noCard: Shoppers place the order now, and you arrange the payment with them.

contact.intro: Shoppers see these on the About page, the home and product pages and in the menu. An empty one is not shown.

pay.title: Card payments
pay.methods: Bank of Georgia · Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay
pay.keysOwn: The payment keys are the store's own: the money goes straight to your bank account, and esy never holds it.
pay.secretHint: The secret key is kept on the server only. Once saved, it is not shown here again.
pay.keptPlaceholder: Saved · type a new one to replace it
pay.disconnectConfirm: Turn card payments off? The keys are deleted and shoppers can no longer pay by card.
pay.off1: Sign an online payments agreement with Bank of Georgia.
pay.off2: Take the Client ID and the secret key (Client secret) from the bank's portal.
pay.offNote: Until it is on, shoppers order without paying online, and you arrange the payment with them.
pay.on1: Shoppers pay by card or Apple Pay on the bank's secure page.
pay.on2: The money reaches your Bank of Georgia account in the bank's usual time. esy never holds it.
pay.on3: Only the owner refunds, from the order's page. The bank confirms a refund later; until then the order shows «refund pending».
pay.onNote: esy's commission ({{percent}}%) is not taken from the payment: it is counted separately, under Finances.
